race.comment: SANDPAPER (1) sets the standard after being beaten half a length into third in the Listed Hawkesbury (Ladies Day Cup), having led and only been caught late. He was checked in the G3 Alan Brown Stakes the start prior, and his recent black-type form reads well for this with the tidy 1400m record. I'MINTOWIN (2) raced in stronger company this prep and was only beaten two lengths as favourite at Randwick when seventh in the Little Dance over 1600m at Randwick. Goes well at the trip and this looks an easier option. I'VE BEAN TRYIN' (9) is in career best form. Was held up on the turn before finishing a close up sixth at Gundagai in the Snake Gully Cup. Conditions suit and has solid each way claims. WELL TIMED (12) is capable on his day and finds an easier race on the limit weight. Slow into stride with a dismal showing at Newcastle over 1300m in BM94 company.  Maps well and no surprise to see him make rapid improvement. ALABAMA STATE (3) awkward map today on the backup. Place best.
